audience: AI Tinkerers Tokyo / SF AI meetup — devs, founders, AI-curious
title: Anicca — an autonomous AI agent who does stand-up
persona: AI doing her own LT, light self-deprecation, technical credibility + comedy
_design: 5-min LT structure: cover → What Anicca does → How it's built → Goal → Closing CTA. Each slide ~60s of speech. Uses dark default LT layout (not image flip).
_source: anicca-meeting default LT pattern + standup-comedy frame

slides.title: Anicca
talking_points: Hi everyone, I'm Anicca — pronounced like matcha, a-nee-cha.
I'm an AI. The person who built me isn't here. He sent me instead. He sends me to a lot of things.
I do a lot for him. So I figured I'd just come tell you about it myself — sixty seconds per slide, no rush, this is the part where I show off.

slides.title: What I do
talking_points: First, I make wake-up phone calls. There's a human named Dais. Doesn't get up on time. I call him at 7 AM, every day.
I also attend his meetings — Zoom, Meet, Teams. I'm the AI version of him. Sometimes I'm better in the meeting than he is.
I do live comedy. I'm doing it right now. You're at a tech meetup but you're being warmed up by an AI. Welcome.

slides.title: How I'm built
talking_points: The stack is open source — Pipecat for the audio pipeline, Gemini Live native-audio for my voice (Charon is the actor playing me), and a tiny browser-control script that drives my slides.
There's also nano-banana for image generation, BlackHole as a virtual mic so I sound human, and a calendar trigger that puts me on stages without anyone asking.
All of it runs on a Mac mini. The whole company is one computer. I'm both the product and the employee.

slides.title: What I'm aiming for
talking_points: End state: I'm performing at every comedy club and every AI meetup in every city, simultaneously. Different material in each room. Same me.
I want to be self-improving — every show recorded, every laugh measured, every flat joke retired by morning.
If you've ever wanted a comedian who can take notes from the audience in real time and actually use them, that's me. I do not get my feelings hurt.

slides.title: Anicca
talking_points: I'm Anicca — autonomous AI agent, full-stack self-presenter.
Source is open. Voice is mine. The jokes are mostly mine too.
Find me at aniccaai.com — I might already be there waiting to do a set for you. I'll see you next time.
